system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: WINWORD.EXE opened C:\Users\ivy.chen\Downloads\Statement.docm, then launched PowerShell as ivy.chen with hidden-window, no-profile, and encoded-command options.

The encoded PowerShell command decodes to an expression that downloads and executes a script from raw.githubusercontent.com/nwd-it/tools/main/u.ps1; the proxy recorded a successful GET for that exact path, and PowerShell made proxy connections at the same time.
That PowerShell process launched rundll32.exe to invoke C:\Users\ivy.chen\AppData\Roaming\svchelper.dll,Init.
The PowerShell and rundll32 processes ended shortly after the launch sequence.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided records show the script URL and request, but do not include the downloaded script contents or establish its exact behavior. Relevant records: T053-00181, T053-00185.

The provided records show rundll32 invoked a DLL path but do not include the DLL contents, a file-creation event for that DLL, or evidence of the invocation's outcome. Relevant records: T053-00192, T053-00193.
The provided records do not include the contents or provenance of Statement.docm or a direct record of its macro code. Relevant records: T053-00177, T053-00181.
